requirement.original: In the Codex tool-call popup, the Description field displays the raw command string (/bin/bash -lc "...") instead of a human-readable description. Both Description and Input Parameters.description share the same raw-command source — they must diverge: Description = real description (model-provided natural-language summary), command belongs only in Input Parameters / command code block. When no real description is available, hide Description OR show a short synthesized summary (e.g. "Running bash"). This is spec §5.7.
requirement.clarified: Modify ToolFullView.ToolDescriptionSection to guard against rendering tool.description when it is null, empty, or identical to tool.input.command. When tool.description is a real model-provided summary, render it unchanged. For bash-type tools with no real description, either hide the section or show a short synthesized fallback. This fix applies to ALL tools passing through ToolFullView, not just CodexBash.
requirement.what: Add render-layer guard in ToolFullView.ToolDescriptionSection to prevent raw command strings from appearing in the Description section
requirement.why: Codex tool calls populate tool.description from input.description (which is the raw bash command), causing Description and Input Parameters to show identical raw command strings — violating the UX contract that Description = human-readable summary

included: Optional synthesized fallback 'Running bash' for bash-type tools
Optional: omit input.description from ToolInputSection JSON when it duplicates tool.description
excluded: CodexBashView.tsx (inline card layer — separate from detail panel)

constraints: Fix must be render-layer only — no changes to data model or description extraction pipeline

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Description section in Codex tool-call detail panel shows the same raw /bin/bash -lc string as Input Parameters.description
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: For Codex exec_command tool calls arriving via the ACP protocol, tool.description is either null (set in typesRaw.ts:1035) or populated from c.input.description (reducer.ts:788, 823). Codex sets input.description to the raw bash command string, not a human summary. ToolFullView.ToolDescriptionSection renders tool.description without a guard, so the raw command string appears verbatim as the Description.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — architectural gap, not a regression
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: ToolDescriptionSection was written assuming tool.description is always a human-readable summary (which holds for Claude Code tools where it comes from envelope.ev.description). No guard was added for the Codex path where description can be absent or a raw command.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Input Parameters section also shows tool.input (including input.description = raw command), making both sections display identical raw bash strings
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since Codex support was introduced; ToolFullView was created in commit 5575d726 (2026-01-25)
